name: A Strange Night
source: Ralph's girlfriend Penny has been cold to him for the last month. What is a horny guy to do? Maybe he can wet his wick in a sexy barmaid Nancy or even a hot policewoman Nessa. Or maybe he can get Penny out of her shell and have some quality time with his own girlfriend...
translation: Ralph的女友Penny已经对他冷淡了一个月。一个欲火中烧的男人该怎么办？也许可以和性感的酒吧女招待Nancy，或火辣的女警察Nessa来一场露水情缘。又或者，让Penny卸下心防，与自己的女友共度一段美好时光……
